title: LegacySourceCodeAnalysisReport
description: Strict JSON Schema specification for LLM-driven structural, functional, and quality analysis of legacy source code modules.

file_path.description: Relative or absolute filesystem path of the analyzed source code file.

programming_language.description: Programming language of the target artifact (e.g., COBOL, Java, C, Python, Fortran).

language_version.description: Specific dialect or language version identified, if determinable.

module_scope.description: Granularity level of the analyzed source code unit.

primary_purpose.description: Concise summary of the functional role fulfilled by this module within the broader application.

symbol_name.description: Name of the function, procedure, class, or routine analyzed.

source_line_start.description: Starting line number of the analyzed block in the source file.

source_line_end.description: Ending line number of the analyzed block in the source file.

analysis_basis.description: Basis used to derive the analysis result.

confidence_level.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 for the evidentiary strength of the analysis.

evidence_summary.description: Short narrative explaining the code evidence used to support the conclusions.

entrypoint_type.description: Runtime mode through which the module is invoked.

trigger_or_invocation.description: How the routine starts or is called in production or the target environment.

runtime_environment.description: Operating system, runtime, server, or platform context where the code executes.

config_files_used.description: Configuration files, parameter files, or environment manifests influencing behavior.

environment_variables_used.description: Environment variables or runtime flags consumed by the logic.

input_schema.description: Input parameters, record fields, or payload elements accepted by the module.

output_schema.description: Output values, generated records, or response fields produced by the module.

data_formats.description: Formats processed by the module such as JSON, CSV, flat file, fixed-width, XML, or DB records.

parameter_validation_rules.description: Rules used to reject or normalize input values.

default_and_null_handling.description: Description of null/default behavior in the module's parameter or result handling.

primary_layer.description: Architectural layer categorization based on primary responsibilities.

layer_confidence_score.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 regarding architectural layer classification.

entry_points.description: Public interfaces, API endpoints, batch triggers, or CLI methods exposed by this module.

state_management_pattern.description: Mechanism used by the module to retain operational state across invocations.

cyclomatic_complexity.description: Estimated control flow complexity based on linearly independent execution paths.

maintainability_index.description: Composite index scaled between 0 and 100 capturing maintainability derived from Halstead Volume, Cyclomatic Complexity, and LOC.

lines_of_code.description: Total non-blank lines of code in the module.

comment_density_ratio.description: Ratio of comment lines relative to total non-blank lines of code (0.0 to 1.0).

halstead_volume.description: Algorithmic complexity estimate based on distinct operators and operands.

composite_quality_score.description: Multi-objective weighted quality score calculated via combined MI, CC, and function length parameters.

functional_requirements.description: Comprehensive enumeration of functional requirements and business rules embedded in the source code.

requirement_id.description: Unique identifier for the functional requirement (e.g., REQ-BL-001).

title.description: Short descriptive title of the functional requirement.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the business logic, formulas, or conditional processing rules.

business_rule_type.description: Classification of the extracted business rule.

source_line_range.description: Start and end line numbers where the business logic is defined (e.g., '102-145').

input_parameters.description: Data structures, arguments, or environment variables consumed by this logic.

output_artifacts.description: Return values, modified global states, or external messages generated by this logic.

technical_debt_and_code_smells.description: Identified structural deficiencies, anti-patterns, and deprecated dependencies.

issue_id.description: Unique tracking code for the technical debt item (e.g., DEBT-SEC-004).

category.description: Classification of the identified code smell or technical debt factor.

severity.description: Impact level on operational stability, maintainability, or security.

source_location.description: Specific symbol name or line range associated with the issue.

description.description: Detailed explanation of why the implementation constitutes technical debt.

remediation_strategy.description: Recommended refactoring technique or pattern to eliminate the defect.

internal_module_dependencies.description: List of internal project files, packages, or symbols referenced by this module.

external_library_dependencies.description: Third-party libraries, packages, or vendor SDKs imported by this file.

database_interactions.description: Data access patterns, embedded SQL queries, or ORM calls executed by the code.

network_and_api_calls.description: External HTTP, RPC, message queue, or socket calls originating from this file.

integration_ceiling_risk.description: Flags whether legacy architectural constraints prevent modern API exposure without custom middleware.

authn_authz_checks.description: Description of authentication and authorization controls implemented in the code.

secret_or_credential_usage.description: Whether credentials or secrets are hardcoded, externalized, or encrypted.

pii_handling.description: How personally identifiable or sensitive data is processed, logged, or stored.

injection_risk.description: Assessment of injection exposure such as SQL, command, or shell injection risk.

audit_logging_behavior.description: Whether the module records audit activity for privileged or business-critical operations.

tables_and_entities.description: Database tables, files, or entities read, written, or transformed by the module.

join_and_relationship_usage.description: How key relationships, joins, or mapping logic are handled across data sources.

transaction_boundaries.description: Description of commit, rollback, locking, or database transaction behavior.

file_or_message_io.description: Description of file reads, writes, queue usage, or message exchange performed by the code.

data_classification.description: Classification of the data the module handles, including sensitivity or business criticality.

exception_types_handled.description: Exception or failure conditions explicitly handled by the module.

retry_policy.description: Retry logic used for transient failures or remote operations.

timeout_behavior.description: How timeouts or long-running operations are managed.

rollback_behavior.description: Behavior when partial execution or persistence fails.

logging_and_alerting.description: How the module logs failures and signals operational issues.

unit_test_coverage.description: Assessment of unit test coverage or absence of tests for the module.

integration_test_coverage.description: Description of end-to-end or integration verification for the module.

regression_test_status.description: Whether regression tests exist and whether they are known to pass or fail.

manual_validation_steps.description: Manual checks or scenarios used to validate behavior.

known_issues.description: Known defects, assumptions, or gaps affecting verification confidence.

business_process_owner.description: Business area or functional owner impacted by this module.

criticality_level.description: Business importance of the module to operational continuity.

sla_or_availability_tolerance.description: Service availability, downtime tolerance, or SLA expectations for this module.

regulatory_constraints.description: Regulations or policies relevant to the module's operation.

operational_risk.description: Impact if the module fails, degrades, or is not migrated safely.

recommended_7r_strategy.description: Optimal modernization pathway defined under the standard 7Rs migration taxonomy.

target_architecture_pattern.description: Destination architectural pattern for modern code generation.

refactoring_complexity_level.description: Subjective operational risk associated with migrating this module.

estimated_person_hours.description: Estimated engineering effort required to modernize and validate this module.

strangler_fig_suitability.description: Indicates whether the module can be incrementally intercepted and replaced using the Strangler Fig pattern.

target_technology_stack.description: Recommended language runtimes, frameworks, and libraries for the modern target implementation.

step_by_step_migration_plan.description: Ordered sequence of engineering actions required to migrate this module safely.

run_total_tokens.description: Total token count consumed for this module analysis run.

run_total_elapsed_seconds.description: Total wall-clock elapsed time in seconds summed across all agents for this run.

agents.description: Per-agent token usage keyed by agent name.

model_name.description: Model identifier that executed the work for this agent.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this agent began processing.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this agent finished processing.

elapsed_seconds.description: Elapsed wall-clock time in seconds between started_at and ended_at.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt tokens submitted for this agent during this run.

completion_tokens.description: Completion tokens returned by this agent during this run.

total_tokens.description: Combined prompt and completion tokens for this agent during this run.
